films.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part I)
films.overview: After reclaiming Kaamelott from Lancelot's tyrannical rule, Arthur spares his life, defying Celtic gods. Knights must prove themselves for Table Round seats while Arthur faces new threats as king.

films.title: Asterix: The Secret of the Magic Potion
films.overview: Following a fall during mistletoe picking, Druid Getafix decides that it is time to secure the future of the village. Accompanied by Asterix and Obelix, he undertakes to travel the Gallic world in search of a talented young druid to transmit the Secret of the Magic Potion.

films.title: Kaamelott: The First Chapter
films.overview: Hidden in Rome, King Arthur is planning his return to oppose the army of his former friend Lancelot.
